spellbook.finance/limitations: Deck ownership is enforced by the backend for the authenticated customer. A deck id from another customer is not readable.
Unmatched draft cards remain explicit through cardId null, matched false and missingFields; absence is not proof that a catalog card is unavailable.
Pokemon readiness describes observed deck contents and does not validate tournament legality beyond the checks named in the response.

description: Read one authenticated customer's exact owned and draft card contents for a deck. The response preserves game identity, entry ids, matched catalog identity, quantities, membership recovery count and Pokemon readiness checks. It reports facts only and does not edit a deck or infer missing cards.

deckId.description: The exact deck id returned by the deck workflow. Required.

name: spellbook_deck_contents
